_comment: Phase 5 decision gate — operator-run on the physical device, 2026-08-02.
Reported by the operator from the LLM smoke-test screen of build 0.5.2-warm-ttft.
Every figure here was measured on the phone. Nothing is estimated or scaled.
The one derived value (model_load_ms) is marked as inferred and says so.

device.isa: Armv8.0-A, NEON only — no dotprod, no i8mm, no SVE, no LSE atomics

build.ggml_flags: GGML_NATIVE=OFF, GGML_CPU_ARM_ARCH=armv8-a, ALL_VARIANTS=OFF, KLEIDIAI=OFF, OPENMP=OFF, LLAMAFILE=OFF

model.name: SmolLM2-360M-Instruct
model.note: NOT the shipping quant. The official HuggingFaceTB repo publishes only q8_0; the shipping model is Q4_K_M at 271 MB. Every number below is therefore a FLOOR — the shipping quant moves fewer weight bytes per token on a bandwidth-limited CPU.

runs.label: run 2 (warm — same open model, different prompt)

memory_rss_mb._note: 421 MB for a 386 MB file = the mmapped weights fully faulted in, plus ~35 MB of context, KV cache and compute buffers at n_ctx 512.

model_load_ms.basis: cold-start figure of 3149 ms from build 0.5.1 (which timed from before llama_model_load_from_file) minus the 1240 ms warm TTFT measured here
model_load_ms.status: INFERRED — the operator did not report the MODEL LOAD line directly. Replace with the measured value at the next opportunity.

concurrent_camera_and_model.problem: This 557 MB was measured with the camera pipeline NOT running. A real session runs CameraX plus MediaPipe FaceLandmarker at the same time as the model. Their memory adds on top of the 133 MB baseline, not into it.
concurrent_camera_and_model.status: NOT MEASURED YET — the camera-screen RSS has been outstanding since Phase 2.
concurrent_camera_and_model.consequence_if_large: With q8_0 the sum could reach or exceed the 700 MB budget. Q4_K_M saves ~115 MB and may be required rather than merely preferred.
